_meta.description: Docudesk template references registered by Shillinq. Each entry references a template slug in the docudesk service. Templates render output from x-openregister-aggregations declarations via openconnector sources per ADR-022 + ADR-031.

iv3-detail-2026.csv.name: IV3-detail bestand 2026 (CSV)
iv3-detail-2026.csv.description: CBS-canonical CSV layout for the Iv3-detail bestand. Renders the iv3DetailByTaakveldCategorie aggregation result from GLLine grouped by (periodId, taakveld, categorie). Per-quarter submission via openconnector source cbs-iv3-detail. cbsSpec version: 2026.

kerngegevens-2026.xml.name: Kerngegevens jaarstaten 2026 (XML)
kerngegevens-2026.xml.description: CBS-conformant XML payload for the Kerngegevens jaarstaten bestand. Renders the kerngegevensRatios aggregation result from kernGegevensConfig consuming the closed fiscal-year jaarrekening + inwonerAantal denominators. Annual submission via openconnector source cbs-kerngegevens. cbsSpec version: 2026.

iv3-ozb-2026.csv.name: IV3-OZB bestand 2026 (CSV)
iv3-ozb-2026.csv.description: CBS Iv3-OZB layout CSV for OZB-inkomsten and WOZ-waarden per heffingstijdvak. Renders the iv3OzbByCategorieHeffing aggregation result from GLLine grouped by (periodId, ozbCategorie). Periodic submission via openconnector source cbs-iv3-ozb. cbsSpec version: 2026.

emu-bestand-2026.xml.name: EMU-bestand 2026 (XML)
emu-bestand-2026.xml.description: CBS EMU XML layout for EMU-saldo and EMU-schuld per period. Renders the emuBestandSaldo aggregation result from Iv3Export consuming the ESA-2010 classifier from sibling bookkeeping-emu-reporting. Quarterly and annual submission via openconnector source cbs-emu-bestand. cbsSpec version: 2026.
